description:
"Cast forth a complex rune granting you and your group members Minor Resolve for |cffffff20|r seconds, increasing your Armor by |cffffff2974|r.

You gain Minor Protection for |cffffff20|r seconds, reducing your damage taken by |cffffff5|r%.

The first time you are damaged while below 50% Health, the Minor Protection is consumed to heal you for |cffffff6033|r Health, scaling off your Max Health."
